chunks: They say: 'Shall we go back to our original state in the dust?'
ai.seo_question: What do the disbelievers ask about resurrection in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: This verse captures the disbelievers' rhetorical question regarding bodily resurrection, specifically referencing 'Al-Hafirat' (the grave or earth), which Shia exegetes often interpret as the state of decay from which God will restore them. It highlights the core theological dispute between the materialist denial of the afterlife and the Islamic doctrine of physical resurrection, a key theme in Surah Al-Insan's discourse on the Hereafter.
